title: 1 Samuel 6 — The ark returned from the Pelishtim (Philistines) to Beit-Shemesh (Beth-shemesh)

translation.sourceText: Hebrew Masoretic text (Westminster Leningrad Codex base, Public Domain) — Tanach with Ta'amei Hamikra

verdicts.reasoning: bisḏēh p̄əlištîm šiḇʿâ ḥŏḏāšîm: exact.
lakkōhănîm wəlaqqōsəmîm ... bammeh nəšalləḥennû limqômô: exact.
hāšēḇ tāšîḇû lô ʾāšām 'by all means return to him a guilt-offering': infinitive absolute intensifier; ʾāšām as reparation offering. Exact.

citations: Tov, Textual Criticism of the Hebrew Bible (3rd ed., 2012), on Ketiv/Qere
verdicts.reasoning: Ketiv ʿply / Qere ṭəḥōrê; ʿaḵbərê zāhāḇ 'golden mice'. The note correctly flags the 5/all-cities discrepancy with v 18. Exact.

citations: Tov, Textual Criticism of the Hebrew Bible (3rd ed., 2012), on Ketiv/Qere
verdicts.reasoning: Ketiv ʿplykm / Qere ṭəḥōrêḵem; ûnəṯattem lēʾlōhê yiśrāʾēl kāḇôḏ ... ûmēʿal ʾĕlōhêḵem 'your elohim' (clause 4). Exact.
Re-parsed: hălôʾ kaʾăšer hiṯʿallēl bāhem. 'made sport of them' is the lexical sense (Ex 10:2; Num 22:29; 1 Sam 31:4), replacing the ASV 'wrought wonderfully', which the verb does not mean. Correct.
ʿăḡālâ ḥăḏāšâ ʾeḥāṯ ûšətê p̄ārôṯ ʿālôṯ ... wahăšêḇōṯem bənêhem mēʾaḥărêhem habbāyṯâ: exact.
kəlê hazzāhāḇ ... ʾāšām tāśîmû ḇāʾargaz miṣṣiddô: 'in a coffer beside it'. Exact.
ʾim-dereḵ gəḇûlô yaʿăleh bêṯ šemeš hûʾ ʿāśâ lānû ... miqreh hûʾ hāyâ lānû: exact.
wayyaʾasrûm bāʿăḡālâ wəʾeṯ-bənêhem kālû babbāyiṯ 'shut up ... at home'. Exact.
wəʾēṯ ṣalmê ṭəḥōrêhem: ṭəḥōrîm in the consonantal text here, correctly noted as not a Qere. Exact.
wayyiššarnâ happārôṯ ... hālōḵ wəḡāʿô 'lowing as they went'. Exact.
ûḇêṯ šemeš qōṣərîm qəṣîr-ḥiṭṭîm bāʿēmeq: 'the people of Beit-Shemesh' renders the collective toponym subject. Exact.
wəšām ʾeḇen gəḏôlâ ... wayḇaqqəʿû ʾeṯ-ʿăṣê hāʿăḡālâ ... heʿĕlû ʿōlâ laYHWH: exact.
wəhalwiyyim hôrîḏû: the note's statement that many take the Levites as a harmonizing addition (McCarter) is accurate. Exact.
waḥămiššâ sarnê-p̄əlištîm rāʾû wayyāšuḇû ʿeqrôn: exact.
Five cities in MT order; ṭəḥōrê hazzāhāḇ (consonantal). Exact.

citations: Driver, Notes on the Hebrew Text and the Topography of the Books of Samuel (2nd ed., 1913), ad loc.
LXX 1 Kgdms 6:18 (lithou tou megalou); Targum Jonathan ad loc.
verdicts.reasoning: Re-parsed: wəʿaḏ ʾāḇēl haggəḏôlâ ʾăšer hinnîḥû ʿāleyhā. MT ʾāḇēl is masculine and fails agreement twice (haggəḏôlâ, ʿāleyhā) and contradicts vv 14-15; reading ʾeḇen (n/l graphic confusion) with the LXX, Targum and some Hebrew MSS is the standard correction (Driver; McCarter). 'which remains' is a supplied ellipsis, as in the ASV. The line is philologically sound; it is the wave's only departure from the MT and depends on founder confirmation of the narrow exception (see the even-ha-gedolah glossary verdict).

Re-parsed: wayyaḵ bəʾanšê ḇêṯ-šemeš kî rāʾû baʾărôn YHWH ... šiḇʿîm ʾîš ḥămiššîm ʾelep̄ ʾîš. Partitive bə- 'some of the men', 'looked into' (rāʾâ bə-), and the asyndetic double number are kept; LXX 'sons of Jeconiah' and Josephus's seventy reported. Missing sof pasuq honestly noted. The reception note states that TBWTT does not quote this verse, which keeps it honest.
mî yûḵal laʿămōḏ lip̄nê YHWH hāʾĕlōhîm haqqāḏôš hazzeh: 'this holy Elohim'; wəʾel-mî yaʿăleh mēʿālênû. Exact.
wayyišləḥû malʾāḵîm ʾel-yôšəḇê qiryaṯ-yəʿārîm ... rəḏû haʿălû ʾōṯô ʾălêḵem: exact.

founderDecisionRecommendations.1-1Sam-6:18-great-stone: Ship. ʾāḇēl cannot be construed (two failed agreements, contradiction with vv 14-15); ʾeḇen with LXX, Targum and some Hebrew MSS is the standard correction (Driver 1913; McCarter 1980). Ratify the exception exactly as narrowly worded (MT grammatically impossible + Hebrew-manuscript reading supported by the versions).
founderDecisionRecommendations.2-gentilics: Keep the Kings '-ite' rule in the Former Prophets now (option c); it maps one-to-one to the ASV and is already ratified for Kings. For the later corpus pass, the reviewer prefers (a) '-ite' throughout, with the central pelishtim-caphtor plural becoming 'the Pelishtites', because 'the Pelishtite' beside 'the Pelishtim' is the one jarring pair. No philological issue either way; it is a presentation choice.
founderDecisionRecommendations.3-Judg-6:40-the-Elohim: Confirm. The ratified Kings text explicitly leaves the central narrative-subject rule ('the Elohim') in force and limits the article-less form to predicates, genitives and direct-speech subjects; the brief's paraphrase was inaccurate. Clause 6 applies the ratified text exactly.
founderDecisionRecommendations.4-Judg-6:34-clothed: Ship. lāḇəšâ is literally 'clothed' (BDB; same idiom 1 Chr 12:19; 2 Chr 24:20; Block), and keeping Judges' four verbs distinct is a gain in accuracy.
founderDecisionRecommendations.5-herem: Ship. 'devote(d) to destruction' is the standard modern rendering (NRSV; HALOT) and the only consistent one; it makes the Josh 6 / Josh 10 connection visible without moral editorializing.
founderDecisionRecommendations.6-shofar-promotion: Approve the promotion after the refId fix (EXO-WOH-20:15 for 20:18; optionally add EXO-WOH-19:13). Retire the 1-kings-woh shofar entry to a pointer and let the exodus-woh overlays cite the central id.

paragraphs.text: וַיְהִ֧י אֲרוֹן־יְהוָ֛ה בִּשְׂדֵ֥ה פְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים שִׁבְעָ֥ה חֳדָשִֽׁים׃

i18n.en: And the ark of YHWH was in the territory of the Pelishtim seven months.

notes.official: *bisḏēh p̄əlištîm* 'in the territory of the Pelishtim', literally 'field'; seven months. 'the ark of YHWH' (`aron-ark-of-the-covenant-ark-of-the-elohim-cross-corpus`).

paragraphs.text: וַיִּקְרְא֣וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים לַכֹּהֲנִ֤ים וְלַקֹּֽסְמִים֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר מַֽה־נַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה לַאֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֑ה הוֹדִעֻ֕נוּ בַּמֶּ֖ה נְשַׁלְּחֶ֥נּוּ לִמְקוֹמֽוֹ׃

i18n.en: And the Pelishtim called for the priests and the diviners, saying, "What shall we do with the ark of YHWH? Tell us with what we shall send it to its place."

notes.official: *lakkōhănîm wəlaqqōsəmîm* 'the priests and the diviners'. *hôḏiʿunû bammeh nəšalləḥennû* 'Tell us with what we shall send it'.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ אִֽם־מְשַׁלְּחִ֞ים אֶת־אֲר֨וֹן אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אַל־תְּשַׁלְּח֤וּ אֹתוֹ֙ רֵיקָ֔ם כִּֽי־הָשֵׁ֥ב תָּשִׁ֛יבוּ ל֖וֹ אָשָׁ֑ם אָ֤ז תֵּרָֽפְאוּ֙ וְנוֹדַ֣ע לָכֶ֔ם לָ֛מָּה לֹא־תָס֥וּר יָד֖וֹ מִכֶּֽם׃

i18n.en: And they said, "If you send away the ark of the Elohim of Yisra'el, do not send it empty; but by all means return to him a guilt-offering; then you shall be healed, and it shall be known to you why his hand is not removed from you."

notes.official: *hāšēḇ tāšîḇû lô ʾāšām* 'by all means return to him a guilt-offering' (ASV 'trespass-offering'), under central `qorbanot-sacrificial-offering-vocabulary-cluster-cross-corpus` (cultic *ʾāšām*) and `ashem-asham-guilt-bearing-vocabulary`: a payment of reparation to the offended deity (Milgrom, *Leviticus 1-16*, AB 3, 1991). 'the ark of the Elohim of Yisra'el' (clause 3 of `elohim-referent-and-article-conventions-former-prophets`).

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ מָ֣ה הָאָשָׁם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָשִׁ֣יב לוֹ֒ וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ מִסְפַּר֙ סַרְנֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים חֲמִשָּׁה֙ עפלי [טְחֹרֵ֣י] זָהָ֔ב וַחֲמִשָּׁ֖ה עַכְבְּרֵ֣י זָהָ֑ב כִּֽי־מַגֵּפָ֥ה אַחַ֛ת לְכֻלָּ֖ם וּלְסַרְנֵיכֶֽם׃

i18n.en: And they said, "What is the guilt-offering which we shall return to him?" And they said, "Five golden tumors and five golden mice, according to the number of the lords of the Pelishtim; for one plague was on all of them and on your lords.

notes.official: *ḥămiššâ ṭəḥōrê zāhāḇ* 'five golden tumors' (Qere; Ketiv *ʿplym*, see 5:6; `ketiv-qere-qere-translated-former-prophets`; `ofalim-tehorim-tumors-1-samuel-5-6`) *waḥămiššâ ʿaḵbərê zāhāḇ* 'and five golden mice': *ʿaḵbār* is a small rodent (BDB 'mouse'; Lev 11:29), and the ASV 'mice' is kept. The MT of ch. 5 has not mentioned mice (the LXX adds them at 5:6), and the five mice here, by the number of the lords, differ from v 18, where the mice correspond to all the cities. *sarnê p̄əlištîm* 'the lords of the Pelishtim' (`seranim-lords-of-the-pelishtim-1-samuel`).

paragraphs.text: וַעֲשִׂיתֶם֩ צַלְמֵ֨י עפליכם [טְחֹרֵיכֶ֜ם] וְצַלְמֵ֣י עַכְבְּרֵיכֶ֗ם הַמַּשְׁחִיתִם֙ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ וּנְתַתֶּ֛ם לֵאלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כָּב֑וֹד אוּלַ֗י יָקֵ֤ל אֶת־יָדוֹ֙ מֵֽעֲלֵיכֶ֔ם וּמֵעַ֥ל אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם וּמֵעַ֥ל אַרְצְכֶֽם׃

i18n.en: And you shall make images of your tumors and images of your mice that ravage the land, and you shall give glory to the Elohim of Yisra'el; perhaps he will lighten his hand from off you, and from off your elohim, and from off your land.

notes.official: *ṣalmê ṭəḥōrêḵem* 'images of your tumors' (Qere; `ketiv-qere-qere-translated-former-prophets`; `ofalim-tehorim-tumors-1-samuel-5-6`). *ûnəṯattem lēʾlōhê yiśrāʾēl kāḇôḏ* 'and you shall give glory to the Elohim of Yisra'el', i.e. acknowledge his power (cf. Josh 7:19); *mēʿal ʾĕlōhêḵem* 'from off your elohim', lower case (clause 4 of `elohim-referent-and-article-conventions-former-prophets`).

paragraphs.text: וְלָ֤מָּה תְכַבְּדוּ֙ אֶת־לְבַבְכֶ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֧ר כִּבְּד֛וּ מִצְרַ֥יִם וּפַרְעֹ֖ה אֶת־לִבָּ֑ם הֲלוֹא֙ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר הִתְעַלֵּ֣ל בָּהֶ֔ם וַֽיְשַׁלְּח֖וּם וַיֵּלֵֽכוּ׃

i18n.en: Why then should you harden your hearts, as Mitzrayim and Par'oh hardened their hearts? When he had made sport of them, did they not let them go, and they departed?

notes.official: *hălôʾ kaʾăšer hiṯʿallēl bāhem* 'When he had made sport of them' (ASV 'when he had wrought wonderfully among them'): the Hithpael of *ʿll* with *bə-* means to deal ruthlessly with someone or make a fool of them (BDB; HALOT), as at Ex 10:2, where YHWH speaks of what he did in Mitzrayim, Num 22:29 and 1 Sam 31:4 (`hitallel-made-sport-of-1-samuel-6-6`). The Pelishti priests cite the Exodus tradition. Mitzrayim = Egypt; Par'oh = Pharaoh (`hebrew-proper-name-transliteration-convention-former-prophets`).

paragraphs.text: וְעַתָּ֗ה קְח֨וּ וַעֲשׂ֜וּ עֲגָלָ֤ה חֲדָשָׁה֙ אֶחָ֔ת וּשְׁתֵּ֤י פָרוֹת֙ עָל֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא־עָלָ֥ה עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם עֹ֑ל וַאֲסַרְתֶּ֤ם אֶת־הַפָּרוֹת֙ בָּעֲגָלָ֔ה וַהֲשֵׁיבֹתֶ֧ם בְּנֵיהֶ֛ם מֵאַחֲרֵיהֶ֖ם הַבָּֽיְתָה׃

i18n.en: Now therefore take and prepare a new cart, and two milk cows on which there has come no yoke, and tie the cows to the cart, and bring their calves home, away from them.

notes.official: *ʿăḡālâ ḥăḏāšâ* 'a new cart'; *šətê p̄ārôṯ ʿālôṯ* 'two milk cows', cows that are suckling. Unyoked cows separated from their calves would not naturally leave them, which makes the test of v 9.

paragraphs.text: וּלְקַחְתֶּ֞ם אֶת־אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֗ה וּנְתַתֶּ֤ם אֹתוֹ֙ אֶל־הָ֣עֲגָלָ֔ה וְאֵ֣ת ׀ כְּלֵ֣י הַזָּהָ֗ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֲשֵׁבֹתֶ֥ם לוֹ֙ אָשָׁ֔ם תָּשִׂ֥ימוּ בָאַרְגַּ֖ז מִצִּדּ֑וֹ וְשִׁלַּחְתֶּ֥ם אֹת֖וֹ וְהָלָֽךְ׃

i18n.en: And take the ark of YHWH and lay it on the cart; and put the objects of gold which you return to him as a guilt-offering in a coffer beside it; and send it away, that it may go.

notes.official: *kəlê hazzāhāḇ ... ʾāšām* 'the objects of gold which you return to him as a guilt-offering' (`qorbanot-sacrificial-offering-vocabulary-cluster-cross-corpus`). *bāʾargaz* 'in a coffer' (ASV), a box; the word occurs only in this chapter (vv 8, 11, 15).

paragraphs.text: וּרְאִיתֶ֗ם אִם־דֶּ֨רֶךְ גְּבוּל֤וֹ יַֽעֲלֶה֙ בֵּ֣ית שֶׁ֔מֶשׁ ה֚וּא עָ֣שָׂה לָ֔נוּ אֶת־הָרָעָ֥ה הַגְּדוֹלָ֖ה הַזֹּ֑את וְאִם־לֹ֗א וְיָדַ֙עְנוּ֙ כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יָדוֹ֙ נָ֣גְעָה בָּ֔נוּ מִקְרֶ֥ה ה֖וּא הָ֥יָה לָֽנוּ׃

i18n.en: And watch: if it goes up by the way of its own territory to Beit-Shemesh, then it is he who has done us this great evil; but if not, then we shall know that it was not his hand that struck us; it was a chance that happened to us."

notes.official: *derek gəḇûlô ... bêṯ šemeš* 'by the way of its own territory to Beit-Shemesh' (Beth-shemesh). *miqreh hûʾ hāyâ lānû* 'it was a chance that happened to us': the test separates divine agency from accident.

paragraphs.text: וַיַּעֲשׂ֤וּ הָאֲנָשִׁים֙ כֵּ֔ן וַיִּקְח֗וּ שְׁתֵּ֤י פָרוֹת֙ עָל֔וֹת וַיַּאַסְר֖וּם בָּעֲגָלָ֑ה וְאֶת־בְּנֵיהֶ֖ם כָּל֥וּ בַבָּֽיִת׃

i18n.en: And the men did so, and took two milk cows and tied them to the cart, and shut up their calves at home.

paragraphs.text: וַיָּשִׂ֛מוּ אֶת־אֲר֥וֹן יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־הָעֲגָלָ֑ה וְאֵ֣ת הָאַרְגַּ֗ז וְאֵת֙ עַכְבְּרֵ֣י הַזָּהָ֔ב וְאֵ֖ת צַלְמֵ֥י טְחֹרֵיהֶֽם׃

i18n.en: And they put the ark of YHWH on the cart, and the coffer, and the golden mice, and the images of their tumors.

notes.official: *ṭəḥōrêhem* 'their tumors': here *ṭəḥōrîm* stands in the consonantal text (`ofalim-tehorim-tumors-1-samuel-5-6`).

paragraphs.text: וַיִשַּׁ֨רְנָה הַפָּר֜וֹת בַּדֶּ֗רֶךְ עַל־דֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ בֵּ֣ית שֶׁ֔מֶשׁ בִּמְסִלָּ֣ה אַחַ֗ת הָלְכ֤וּ הָלֹךְ֙ וְגָע֔וֹ וְלֹא־סָ֖רוּ יָמִ֣ין וּשְׂמֹ֑אול וְסַרְנֵ֤י פְלִשְׁתִּים֙ הֹלְכִ֣ים אַחֲרֵיהֶ֔ם עַד־גְּב֖וּל בֵּ֥ית שָֽׁמֶשׁ׃

i18n.en: And the cows went straight on the way, on the way to Beit-Shemesh; they went along one highway, lowing as they went, and did not turn aside to the right or to the left; and the lords of the Pelishtim went after them as far as the border of Beit-Shemesh.

notes.official: *wayyiššarnâ happārôṯ* 'And the cows went straight' (an unusual form of *yšr*); *hālōḵ wəḡāʿô* 'lowing as they went'. 'the lords of the Pelishtim' (`seranim-lords-of-the-pelishtim-1-samuel`).

paragraphs.text: וּבֵ֣ית שֶׁ֔מֶשׁ קֹצְרִ֥ים קְצִיר־חִטִּ֖ים בָּעֵ֑מֶק וַיִּשְׂא֣וּ אֶת־עֵינֵיהֶ֗ם וַיִּרְאוּ֙ אֶת־הָ֣אָר֔וֹן וַֽיִּשְׂמְח֖וּ לִרְאֽוֹת׃

i18n.en: And the people of Beit-Shemesh were reaping their wheat harvest in the valley; and they lifted up their eyes and saw the ark, and rejoiced to see it.

paragraphs.text: וְהָעֲגָלָ֡ה בָּ֠אָה אֶל־שְׂדֵ֨ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֤עַ בֵּֽית־הַשִּׁמְשִׁי֙ וַתַּעֲמֹ֣ד שָׁ֔ם וְשָׁ֖ם אֶ֣בֶן גְּדוֹלָ֑ה וַֽיְבַקְּעוּ֙ אֶת־עֲצֵ֣י הָעֲגָלָ֔ה וְאֶת־הַ֨פָּר֔וֹת הֶעֱל֥וּ עֹלָ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃ (ס)

i18n.en: And the cart came into the field of Yehoshua the Beit-Shimshite, and stood there; and a great stone was there; and they split the wood of the cart and offered up the cows as a burnt-offering to YHWH.

notes.official: *ʾel-śəḏēh yəhôšuaʿ bêṯ-haššimšî* 'into the field of Yehoshua the Beit-Shimshite' (Joshua the Beth-shemite; `hebrew-proper-name-transliteration-convention-former-prophets`). *wəšām ʾeḇen gəḏôlâ* 'and a great stone was there', the stone of vv 15 and 18 (`even-ha-gedolah-the-great-stone-1-samuel-6-18`). The cows are offered as a *ʿōlâ* (`olah-burnt-offering`).

paragraphs.text: וְהַלְוִיִּ֞ם הוֹרִ֣ידוּ ׀ אֶת־אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֗ה וְאֶת־הָאַרְגַּ֤ז אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁר־בּ֣וֹ כְלֵֽי־זָהָ֔ב וַיָּשִׂ֖מוּ אֶל־הָאֶ֣בֶן הַגְּדוֹלָ֑ה וְאַנְשֵׁ֣י בֵֽית־שֶׁ֗מֶשׁ הֶעֱל֨וּ עֹל֜וֹת וַֽיִּזְבְּח֧וּ זְבָחִ֛ים בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא לַֽיהוָֽה׃

i18n.en: And the Levites took down the ark of YHWH, and the coffer that was with it, in which were the objects of gold, and put them on the great stone; and the men of Beit-Shemesh offered burnt-offerings and sacrificed sacrifices on that day to YHWH.

notes.official: *wəhalwiyyim hôrîḏû* 'And the Levites took down': many commentators take the Levites' appearance after the sacrifice has begun as a later harmonization with the law of Num 4 (McCarter, *I Samuel*). *ʿōlôṯ ... zəḇāḥîm* 'burnt-offerings ... sacrifices' (`olah-burnt-offering`; `qorbanot-sacrificial-offering-vocabulary-cluster-cross-corpus`).

paragraphs.text: וַחֲמִשָּׁ֥ה סַרְנֵֽי־פְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים רָא֑וּ וַיָּשֻׁ֥בוּ עֶקְר֖וֹן בַּיּ֥וֹם הַהֽוּא׃ (ס)

i18n.en: And when the five lords of the Pelishtim had seen it, they returned to Eqron that day.

notes.official: *waḥămiššâ sarnê-p̄əlištîm* 'the five lords of the Pelishtim' (`seranim-lords-of-the-pelishtim-1-samuel`).

paragraphs.text: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ טְחֹרֵ֣י הַזָּהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵשִׁ֧יבוּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֛ים אָשָׁ֖ם לַֽיהוָ֑ה לְאַשְׁדּ֨וֹד אֶחָ֜ד לְעַזָּ֤ה אֶחָד֙ לְאַשְׁקְל֣וֹן אֶחָ֔ד לְגַ֥ת אֶחָ֖ד לְעֶקְר֥וֹן אֶחָֽד׃ (ס)

i18n.en: And these are the golden tumors which the Pelishtim returned as a guilt-offering to YHWH: for Ashdod one, for Azzah one, for Ashqelon one, for Gat one, for Eqron one;

notes.official: The five cities of the Pelishtim: Ashdod, Azzah (Gaza), Ashqelon (Ashkelon), Gat (Gath) and Eqron (Ekron) (`hebrew-proper-name-transliteration-convention-former-prophets`). *ṭəḥōrê hazzāhāḇ* 'the golden tumors': here *ṭəḥōrîm* is the consonantal text, not a Qere (`ofalim-tehorim-tumors-1-samuel-5-6`). *ʾāšām* 'a guilt-offering'.

paragraphs.text: וְעַכְבְּרֵ֣י הַזָּהָ֗ב מִסְפַּ֞ר כָּל־עָרֵ֤י פְלִשְׁתִּים֙ לַחֲמֵ֣שֶׁת הַסְּרָנִ֔ים מֵעִ֣יר מִבְצָ֔ר וְעַ֖ד כֹּ֣פֶר הַפְּרָזִ֑י וְעַ֣ד ׀ אָבֵ֣ל הַגְּדוֹלָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִנִּ֤יחוּ עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ אֵ֚ת אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֔ה עַ֚ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה בִּשְׂדֵ֥ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בֵּֽית־הַשִּׁמְשִֽׁי׃

i18n.en: and the golden mice, according to the number of all the cities of the Pelishtim belonging to the five lords, both fortified city and country village, even unto the great stone on which they set down the ark of YHWH, which remains unto this day in the field of Yehoshua the Beit-Shimshite.

notes.official: *ʿîr miḇṣār wəʿaḏ kōp̄er happərāzî* 'both fortified city and country village'. *wəʿaḏ ʾeḇen haggəḏôlâ* 'even unto the great stone': the MT reads *ʾāḇēl* 'meadow' (or a place name Avel), which disagrees with the feminine adjective *haggəḏôlâ* and the feminine *ʿāleyhā* 'on which' and cannot be construed. Some Hebrew manuscripts, the LXX and the Targum read *ʾeḇen* 'stone', the stone of vv 14-15, which the ASV and modern versions follow (Driver, *Notes*; McCarter). The line adopts *ʾeḇen* under `even-ha-gedolah-the-great-stone-1-samuel-6-18`; ratified at human sign-off (2026-11-01), it is the single narrow exception to the MT-baseline rule in the Former Prophets wave, made only because the MT cannot be construed. The KJV conflates both readings ('unto the great stone of Abel'). 'which remains' is supplied, as the ASV supplies '[which stone remaineth]' (`ad-ha-yom-ha-zeh-aetiological-formula`). The lords and the mice (`seranim-lords-of-the-pelishtim-1-samuel`).

paragraphs.text: וַיַּ֞ךְ בְּאַנְשֵׁ֣י בֵֽית־שֶׁ֗מֶשׁ כִּ֤י רָאוּ֙ בַּאֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֔ה וַיַּ֤ךְ בָּעָם֙ שִׁבְעִ֣ים אִ֔ישׁ חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף אִ֑ישׁ וַיִּֽתְאַבְּל֣וּ הָעָ֔ם כִּֽי־הִכָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה בָּעָ֖ם מַכָּ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה

i18n.en: And he struck some of the men of Beit-Shemesh, because they had looked into the ark of YHWH; he struck of the people seventy men, fifty thousand men; and the people mourned, because YHWH had struck the people with a great slaughter.

notes.official:
*wayyaḵ bəʾanšê ḇêṯ-šemeš kî rāʾû baʾărôn YHWH* 'And he struck some of the men of Beit-Shemesh, because they had looked into the ark of YHWH': *rāʾâ bə-* 'look at, look into' (ASV 'looked into'), with partitive *bə-* 'some of the men'. The LXX reads instead 'and the sons of Jeconiah did not rejoice among the men of Beth-shemesh when they saw the ark', which many prefer (McCarter). *šiḇʿîm ʾîš ḥămiššîm ʾelep̄ ʾîš* 'seventy men, fifty thousand men': the two numbers stand side by side without a conjunction. The total of 50,070 is very large for a village; some Hebrew manuscripts and Josephus (*Ant.* 6.16) have seventy only, and the larger figure is often taken as a gloss. The MT is translated as it stands (`mt-baseline-at-versional-cruxes-former-prophets`). The source text of this verse lacks the final *sof pasuq*; it is kept as delivered.

**Wheel of Heaven reading (reception note, not a translation claim).** The Book Which Tells the Truth (ch. 3) does not quote this verse. It reads the ark of 1 Sam 5 as an apparatus that harmed those who handled it without precautions, and cites 2 Sam 6:6-7 (Uzzah) as a further case. The line renders the Hebrew literally and does not encode that reading.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י בֵֽית־שֶׁ֔מֶשׁ מִ֚י יוּכַ֣ל לַעֲמֹ֔ד לִפְנֵ֨י יְהוָ֧ה הָאֱלֹהִ֛ים הַקָּד֖וֹשׁ הַזֶּ֑ה וְאֶל־מִ֖י יַעֲלֶ֥ה מֵעָלֵֽינוּ׃ (ס)

i18n.en: And the men of Beit-Shemesh said, "Who is able to stand before YHWH, this holy Elohim? And to whom shall he go up from us?"

notes.official: *mî yûḵal laʿămōḏ lip̄nê YHWH hāʾĕlōhîm haqqāḏôš hazzeh* 'Who is able to stand before YHWH, this holy Elohim?': the Hebrew has the article, rendered by the demonstrative 'this' that follows (clause 1 of `elohim-referent-and-article-conventions-former-prophets`). *wəʾel-mî yaʿăleh mēʿālênû* 'And to whom shall he go up from us?'

paragraphs.text: וַֽיִּשְׁלְחוּ֙ מַלְאָכִ֔ים אֶל־יוֹשְׁבֵ֥י קִרְיַת־יְעָרִ֖ים לֵאמֹ֑ר הֵשִׁ֤בוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים֙ אֶת־אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֔ה רְד֕וּ הַעֲל֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ אֲלֵיכֶֽם׃

i18n.en: And they sent messengers to the inhabitants of Qiryat-Ye'arim, saying, "The Pelishtim have brought back the ark of YHWH; come down and take it up to you."

notes.official: Qiryat-Ye'arim = Kiriath-jearim (`hebrew-proper-name-transliteration-convention-former-prophets`). *malʾāḵîm* 'messengers', human envoys (`malakh-yhwh-messenger`). 'the ark of YHWH' (`aron-ark-of-the-covenant-ark-of-the-elohim-cross-corpus`).
